{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
# We already saw it's a string, so we'll test if any contain commas
contains_comma = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {contains_comma.sum()}")
print(f"Sample of revenue values with commas: {df.loc[contains_comma, 'revenue'].head(10).tolist()}")

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# Also check if any are invalid (e.g., '999999.99' for QA orders, but we already know there are none)
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify no QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders after cleaning: {qa_orders}")"}
